tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol mdos bar gcod kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/

gang gis zhabs pad gus bsten cing*/ /mchod par byed pa de kun kyang*/ /phongs ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las/ /mngon skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir sgrol mdos ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ de la yang rgyas bsdus mi 'du ba 'ga' re snang ba las 'bring bo'i dbang du byas nas 'chad do/ /'di'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ dgos pa ni byad kha dang god kha gcod pa dang gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa bzlog pa dang rims nad zhi bar byed pa sogs mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byed pa dang*/ 'dod don rnams 'grub par 'gyur pa'o/ /brgyud pa ni jo bo rje nas bka' gdams gong ma rnams dang da lta'i bar gyi sa dge'i bla chen dag gis phyag len du mdzad de dar ro/ /cho ga la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos bzhi gnyis las dang po ni/ gnas khang yid du 'ong ba'i gang rung du stegs ji ltar 'tsham pa la dri bzang byugs te rdul mtshan nam/ shog ras sogs la grub bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris pa'i lte bar mañji sogs stegs kyi steng du rjai btsun ma'i sku byin can bzhugs su gsol la/ /de nyid kyi dbu thog tu dar dkar gyi gur phub/ mthar chu gcig nyer spyod tshang ba nyer gcig gam ci 'byor gtsang mar bsham/ pad 'dab can nam sked dkris can gyi gtor ma bzhi/ rje btsun ma'i g.yas g.yon gang rung du mdos gdan gyi steng du gser skyem brdar nas bsres pa'i 'jim pa la/ spe'u spe zhol lcags ri dang bcas pa ji ltar 'tsham pa zhes 'byung ba'i don la phyag len cung mi 'dra ba re mdzad pa mthong zhing*/ kha cig spe'u spe zhol ces pa ni gtsang skad de rgya mkhar lan kan dang bcas pa lta bu'i zhes 'dod pa ni 'thad par mngon no/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa ni mkhar gyi dbang sor bzhi sogs ji ltar rigs par byas pa'i nang gi dbus cung zad mthong bar zan las byas pa'i ngar mi mtho gang ba gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis spras pa rta la zhon pa bya'o/

kha cig 'di ni thog khang du byed do/ /paṇa chen gyi der g.yon du nam mkha' dang rgyang bu gsum gsum zhes 'byung yang*/ /gzhung gzhan gsum na g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams la nam mkha' dang rgyang bu gsum re bya bar bshad pa ltar 'thad cing*/ /pho gdong mo gdong*/ mda' khra phang khra rnams kyang gsum gsum las mi nyung ba 'dzug /'dzug tshul la mi mthun pa yod kyang*/ lcags ri'i nang ngos zur bzhi nas ka ba lta bu dpangs khru gang ba bzhi btsugs pa'i steng du so 'debs gyi gdung byas pa la phyogs bzhir nam mkha' dang rgyang bu sogs btsugs na legs shing mdos spyi dang yang mthun la 'og tu yid 'ong khang ba spe'u zhol dang zhes dang mthun snyam mo/ /dbus kyi dar ma'i lus kyi g.yon du nam mkha' dang rgyang bu chung ngu re gnyis 'dzug dgos pa ni 'og tu nam rgyang ldem pas sku la brgyan/ zhes pas kyang bstan no/ /gser skyem bkres pa'i zan gyi ngar mi sum cu/ mdzo rta gnag lug ri dwags byi ba sogs sa la 'dzul dgu dang*/ bya byi'u sogs gnam la 'phur dgu'i gzugs dang*/ 'bru sman rin chen zas gos dar sna sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis lcags ri'i nang 'geng*/ la dgu lung dgu'i chu sna yang 'tshogs par byas la/ mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod gtor ma rnams ci 'byor dang*/ pad 'dab can gyi gtor ma drug rnams bsham/ phyogs bzhir mkha' dang re re 'jug pa'am min kyang nam mkha' 'thus la/ gzhan ngar ma'i steng du dar dkar gyi phub 'bums bang bshad pa'i don 'bubs tshul mi 'dra ba mthong ste/ kha cig lcags ri'i nang ngos nas bzung ste sho gu la lta bu'i khang pa gru bzhi ba gcig gi go chod pa byas nas dbus su srog shing dang bcas pa'i mda' dar ram nam mkha' 'dzug la/ kha cig phyi nang gnyis byas pa'i nang ma mtho ba khang brtsegs gyi tshul du byas nas sngar ltar 'dzug pa dang*/ la la ni skud pa las gur dang khang brtsegs lta bu dang*/

gzhan dag nang gi dar ma'i steng dud dkar dang sho gu las gur chung byed pa sogs du ma mthong ngo*/ /de dag gang byas kyang 'gal ba cher med mod 'on kyang dbus kyi dar mi'i mtha' nas sor bzhi re tsam song bzhi phyogs bzhir snyug ma sogs phyi ma las mtho bar btsugs te/ phyogs bzhi nas brtan pa'i thabs byas pa'i steng du dar dkar dang shog dkar gyi gur gru bzhi dbus mtho la sngar ltar mda' dar sogs btsugs na legs sam snyam ste lag len mi 'dra bas rang gis kyang dpyad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ tshogs zhing dang bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa dang lhan cig byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar sbyar te byin gyis brlabs la/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tāṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis/ /nas sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo ār+ya tā re maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥ.oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces pa lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig

/ sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/ /de nas bdag mdun gnyis la lha drug bskyed dang cho ga gsum bskyed gang byas kyang rung zhing*/ mdos cho ga snga ma dag las lha drug bskyed mdzad do/ /'dir 'jug pa bde ched cho ga gsum bskyed bya ste/ de ni/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i dang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i steng du tāṃ yig ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las ut+pal sngon po tā yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag gnyis ut+pal sngon pos mtshan pa zhi zhing 'dzums/ sgeg pa'i nyams can/ mdzes shing yid 'phrog par byed pa/ dbu skra ral ba phyed thor cog gi tshul du bcings shing*/ /lhag ma lan bur 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan do shal la sogs pa rin chen rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i phyed skyil gyi tshul du gzhugs pa/ 'di'i cho ga snga ma rnams las mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa zhes 'byung yang*/ gsang 'dus sogs gzhung gzhan nas lha mo la dbu'i gtsug tor dang 'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su rung ba'i mtshan sogs 'ga' re med par bshad pas brtag dgos par snang ngo*/ /rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros po ta la dang g.yu lo bkod pa la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas rje btsun sgrol ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/

po ta la yi gnas mchog zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ /oṃ pañca sū la pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swahā'i bar kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shrī e hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i tāṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sogs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ zhes yi ge bcu ba gang mang bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod de/ /sngar bzhin mchod la/ bdag gi tshe rabs sngon nas zhes sogs kyis bstod/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag / ces sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo// //de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ bskyed cing byin gyis brlab pa yin la/ 'on kyang 'dir shap+ta'i rjes su rū ba sogs 'dod yon lnga yang bskyed cing byin brlab bya'o/ / de nas mdun gyi rten la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ sā bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/

zhes pa nas/ mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la la sogs pa'i rang gzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun sgrol ma la yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong srung ma phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'byung bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'gro kun srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i gru gzings kyis/ /sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed dam bcas pa/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /po ta la yi gnas nas don du gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang*/ /bstan srung sde brgyad rigs drug mgon/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po rbad 'dre sogs/ /mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra e h+ye hi nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas rje btsun ma la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur bar bsams/ mchod pa ni/ rab 'byams zhing na yod pa'i mchod tshogs dang*/ /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rje btsun sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ nas de bzhin sbyar te shap+ta'i bar dang gzugs mchod sogs dad rū ba nas sbar+sha'i bar gyis mchod la/ lha dang lha min sogs dang*/ oṃ rje btsun ma/ nas phyag 'tshal pa ni nyi shu rtsa gcig / ces nyer gcig brjod de sngags ci sgrub dang grub na sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa mang 'don cing slar sngar bzhin sngags tsam gyis mchod pa'am/ yang rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa byas kyang rung*/ de nas gtor ma cha bzhi la chab bran te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snong yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gtor ma dang po oṃ gu ru mūḥl mū la a kā ro zhes sogs lan gsum gyis bla ma dang*/ gnyis pa/ oṃ tri rat+na a kā ro gsum gyis dkon mchog gsum dang*/ gsum pa/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra a kā ro gsum gyis sgrol ma 'khor bcas dang*/ bzhi ba/ oṃ shrī dharmāḥpā la sa bā ri wa ra a kā ro gsum gyis chos skyong spyi la 'bul/ yang na rang rang gi gtor 'bul bzhin byas kyang chog go /de nas oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ ces sogs kyis mchod de/ 'di ltar/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /nas= kun nas dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ khyed kyis bar chad rims nad 'byung bo'i gdon/ /dus min 'chi dang rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan/ /'jigs chen sdug bsngal brgyad sogs nyer 'tshe kun/ /myur du zhi zhing srung bar mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi/ /nas 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pas/ /nas so sor 'joms gyur cig / ces gsol gdab bya'o/ /de nas mdos gtor mchod pa sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ / a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las grub ba'i khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba/ dbus su yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams kyi glud ngar mi phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dang*/ nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' khra phang khra pho gdong mo gdong gtor ma rin chen 'bru sman sogs 'dod rgu'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shung+nghe ngharmāḥ zhes sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/

bdag gi bsam pa'i nas 'byung gyur cig / de nas gtor ma cha drug gi dang po phyogs skyong la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ru tra ye/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra a k+ṣi ye/ oṃ ak+ṇi ye/ oṃ ya ma ye/ oṃ ni re te ye/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye/ oṃ ba ye bai ye/ ung+nghaṃ bra h+ma ṇa ye/ su r+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a nghi ba ta ye/ oṃ adha bra thi yi bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥnā ge bh+yaḥs bā ri wa ra bra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang/ oṃ ru tra ye nas sa pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ bi shwa nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum bsdu na oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra zhes sogs kyis 'bul/ / shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje gdon bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung bo'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang*/ /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la/ /so so so sor gtor ma 'bul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang dang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang bdug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzad/

gtor ma gnyis pa gzhi bdag la 'bul ba ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /stong gsum gzhi bdag tshogs rnams dang*/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan mar bcas/ /gangs can gnas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /las dang bya ba ci byas kyang*/ /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs brjod/ gtor ma gsum pa sde brgyad spyi la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ gan+dha rba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ma nu ṣa/ a ma nu ṣa sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga nas wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā bh+yoḥ nas ba liṃ ta swāhā/ lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthus/ /lha klu lha min dri za dang*/ /mkha' lding srul po lus srul po/ /grul bum skyo byed brjed byed dang*/ /gnod sbyin gshin rje srin po dang*/ /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyi/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor kun zhi zhing*/ /'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub par shog / gtor ma bzhi pa sgos su gdon bgegs la bsngo ba ni/ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi bi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ oṃ gung ka ri nas wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ na mo/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags dang*/ /rten 'brel slu med bden byin gyis/

/gang zhig sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod pa'i gdon bgegs tshogs rnams dang*/ /'byung bo yi dwags sha za dang*/ /klu gnyan sa bdag rgyal po dang*/ ma mo bdud btsun 'gong bo sogs/ /ji snyed mchis shing rgyu ba yi/ /gnod byed gdon gyi rigs rnams la/ /'dod rgu'i dam rdzas 'di ster zhing*/ /bslu med bden pa'i chos 'chad kyis/ /rbad 'dre rbod gtor phur kha dang*/ /mig nad phyugs nad god kha ngan/ gdon dang bgegs kyi gnod pa dang*/ /dus min 'chi dang sgo gsum gyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi gyur cig / gtor ma lnga pa rigs drug gi mgron la bsngo ba ni/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta nas sam+bha ra hūm̐ lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /'gro ba rigs drug lam brgyud lnga/ /skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i tshogs la 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /rig drug sdug bsngal las grol zhing*/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems nyid dang*/ /yang dag lta bas rgyud phyug ste/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs rdzogs nas/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog / gtor ma drug pa lan chags gyi mgron la bsngo ba ni/ na maḥsarba nas sam+bha ra hūm̐ lan gsum/ phun tshogs= /bdud rtsi= /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /bsad dang bcings dang brdeg pa dang*/ /'phrog dang brkus la sogs pa yi/ /lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba dang*/ /bu lon chags pa rnams la bsngo/ /mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /lan chags sha 'khon ma lus dag /bu lon rnams kyang 'khyer gyur nas/ /rgyur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dam pa thob bar shog /bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid sgrol ma yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal bo rta mgrin dmar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa can du gyur/

/hūm̐ nga ni khro rgyal rta mgrin te/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid che/ /dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'dir ni bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mchod sbyin chen po glud dang bcas/ /yon bdag glud du khyod la 'bul/ /'di la gnod pa ma mdzad cig /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad po/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' nyon la/ /gzhan gyis rbad par ma nyan cig /gdon bgegs chen po thams cad kyang*/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar gyis/ khyed rnams dgyes pa'i gtor ma dang*/ /srog chags nor glud mang po dang*/ /la rdzas lung rdzas 'dod rgur bcas/ /yid 'ong khang ba spe'u zhol dang*/ /dar gyi gur phub ldi ri ri/ /'bru tshom dgu yi khri la bzhag /ngar glud rgyun can sna tshogs dang*/ /yid 'ong rta yi tshogs mgyogs la/ /'bru yi ngar mi chen po bskyon/ /lus la gser g.yu'i rgyan cha btags/ /rgyan cha yid 'ong si li li/ /dar gyi gos gyon lhubs se lhubs/ /smra ba mkhas dang 'dzum mdangs can/ /'og na rta zhon zhungs se zhungs/ /mgo la thod bcings pu ru ru/ /rtsed 'jo sna tshogs bsgyur la mkhas/ /g.yu mi lham chung zu lu lu/ /gser gyi ska rags khyug se khyug /nam rgyang ldem pa sku la brgyan/ /pho gdong mo gdong mi skad smra/ /mnga' rigs 'dod rgur tshar ba rnams/ /yon bdag glud du khyed la bul/ /yid 'ong nor ni mang po dang*/ /zhal zas zhim dgu mngar dgu dang*/ /'khor g.yog dar mi sum cu dang*/ /sman spos sgron me gsal ba rnams/ khyed la mchod par 'bul lags kyi/ /stags pa phur bu bsgril ba dang*/ /yungs kar thun gyis brab pa dang*/ /zor kha sna tshogs 'phen pa dang*/ /gtad gnon sbyor ba byed pa rnams/ /de dag nus pa phyir zlog cig /bon po rnga gshang brdung ba dang*/ /sngo dmar 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang*/ /btso dmar 'phen par byed pa zlog /drag sngags phra men gnod pa dang*/ /sde brgyad drag po bskul ba

rnams/ /de dag nus pa phyir zlog cig /chos skyong lha 'dre thams cad kyang*/ /la la dkor cha'i shul du 'brang*/ /la la mna' zan gshed du 'ong*/ /la la sngags pas drag por rbad/ /la la bden pa'i rgyu 'bras ston/ /la la rim nad dal yams gtong*/ /'ga' zhig sad dang ser ba gtong*/ /char mi 'bab dang lo nyes byed/ /lan chags bu lon 'ded pa dang*/ /nye 'brel grogs kyi shul du 'brang*/ /mdze nad gtong ba'i klu rnams dang*/ /gnod byas lan ldon klu rnams dang*/ /sha khrag srog dbugs za ba dang*/ /'bras bu lo tog za ba dang*/ /ngar snabs mi gtsang za ba dang*/ /'byung ba'i lha dang sa bdag dang*/ /lo dang sbar khar sme bar bcas/ kun kyang glud kyis mnyes gyur cig /gnod 'gal na ba zhi bar mdzod/ /bu lon lan chags dag zhal lo/ /bdag cag longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /rkyen ngan bar gcod phyir zlog cig /rbod gtong nus pa bzlog tu gsol/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /byams pa'i sems kyis mchod sbyin bgyi/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis dam chos bshad/ khyod kyang ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da ni byams sems ldan par gyis/ /rang rang lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan gyi lus la gnod ma byed/ /sdig sbyong thar pa'i lam la snyegs/ /nad dang dal yams bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod dang*/ /lo tog char chu rgyas par mdzod/ /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu= /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nad rnams zlog /stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon rnams= /yas bdud g.yos dang mas sri langs/ /pha chen rgya 'dre thams cad dang*/ /ma sru'i byur 'dra thams cad= /lo zla zhag dus ngan pa zlog /phung 'dre thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /srid la brku ba bzlog tu gsol/ / byis pa'i gdon rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /mi kha kha mchu ma gtong zhig /gzhan gyi g.yul ngo zhi bar gyis/ /bdag gi dmag thabs legs par mdzad/ /myos shing 'thibs pa bsal ba dang*/

/nyin gcig nyin gnyis nyin gsum pa/ /rims nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /nyam nga 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol/ /yur phyogs dge bar mdzad du gsol/ /dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'thab rtsod zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /bkra shis ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /bsod nams nyi 'od bzhin du 'bar bar shog /mi phyed mi gzhig kun gyi dngos grub stsol/ / tshar lan 'ga' gtong na mchod pa kha gsol te byin gyis brlabs la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig nas 'di'i bar sngar ltar bya'o/ /de nas mdos 'phen pa la/ paṇa chen kyi mdos chog las zor 'phen pa'i tshul ma bshad cing*/ 'di'i mdos chog kha cig tu gtor zor 'phen par bshad kyang 'phen tshul mi gsal/ 'di'i mdos chog la lar rnying lugs gyi rgyas bkab ste/ gtor zor/ tshe zor/ yungs zor/ kong zor/ khrag zor/ mda' zor rnams kyang 'phen par bshad de/ rkyen sems tsam la de dag mi rung ba mi snang ste brtag /'di lugs kyi zor 'phen na gtor zor che chung ci 'dod pa bzhin byas te/ a mṛ tas bsangs swabhā was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las zor gnam lcags kyi thog zor me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba zhi khro lha srin sde brgyad kyi nus mthu thams cad zor gyi rnam par bkug nas gtor zor ba thim par gyur/ zhes pa lan gsum mam gcig bya'o/ /de nas mdos sna 'khrid mkhan dang*/ gser skyems/ rol mo mdos rgyab pa dang bcas te mdos 'phen pa'i sar phyin te rang rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di ltar/ // hriḥ nga ni khrag 'thung rta mchog dpal/ /srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /nyon cig lha srin sde brgyad tshogs/ /'dod dgu'i char gyis tshim gyis te/ /rang rang lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams/ /bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol/

/mnan pa khyogs la bsdams pa lhod/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor rgyun chod la/ /'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin sgrubs/ /mchod sbyin rten 'brel thabs ma bslu/ /gal te bka' las 'das byed na/ /rab 'jigs kho bo'i tshogs sbros te/ /mi bzad mtshon cha'i char chen gyis/ /brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ / zhes dang yang na/ chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos skyong sde brgyad 'khor bcas kyis/ /mdos zor 'di yi sna drongs la/ /gzhan gyi bsam sbyor zhes pa nas/ thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ / zhes pa'i 'jug du rdo rje slob dpon gyis rta mgrin gyi sngags/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta grid badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de/ gtor zor 'phen la/ zor gzhan rnams kyang 'dod na de bzhin byas nas 'pha ེ na du rung ro/ /de nas rta mgrin gyi sngags dang sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod nas 'tshams bcad la/ rdo rje'i gur bsgoms shing nang du 'ongs nas/ btang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas sngar bzhin byas te/ bstod nas yig brgya'i mthar na rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol byas te/ /ye shes pa la 'di ni rten dang lhan cig tu zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod la bsngo smon dang shis brjod bya'o/ /gal te rten ma rnyed na tshom bu bkod de ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar byas pa'i phan yon ni/ 'dod dgu thams cad 'di yis 'byung*/ /ngan dgu thams cad 'di yis bzlog /ces mgon po klu sgrub kyis gsungs zhes grags pa ltar ro/ /zhes pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis rje btsun ma'i 'phrin las spail ba dang*/ gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas dam pa snga ma 'gas mdzad pa'i mdos chog rnams la brtags te mthong brgyad gyi phyag len bzhin dogs gcod dang bcas co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i par kyi yig ge pa ni dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis so//
// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/sgrol mdos bar gcod kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 360-- PAGE 359-- PAGE 346-
